page.overview:
Who is No Face?

No Face was a member of the Black Dragon organization who made his debut in Mortal Kombat: Special Forces.

Fitting to his name, No Face had a bizarre pale complexion without nose, ears or hair. He wore a brown shirt and pants with dynamite strapped to his chest and the fuel canisters for his flamethrower strapped to his back.

No Face was freed from prison by Kano and set up a hideout located in an abandoned warehouse, where he fought Jax, but was eventually defeated and killed by him.
